# outcome_label

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Assigns an evidence-backed outcome class without allowing self-reported success to confirm itself.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label_id` | `string` | yes | Stable outcome label identity. |
| `episode_id` | `string` | yes | Exact episode being labeled. |
| `outcome_class` | `string` | yes | Observed outcome class. |
| `confidence_basis` | `string` | yes | Independent basis for label confidence. |
| `independent_evidence_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of evidence outside the candidate policy claim. |
